= some g ∧ a + b + j ∈ g.inputs}.ncard → (¬ ∃ (k k' w : ℕ) (g g' : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[k]? = some g ∧ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ (g.inputs = [a + b + j, w] ∨ g.inputs = [w, a + b + j]) ∧ (∀ x : Fin (a + b) → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD w false = true → ∃ (p : Fin a) (l : Fin b), E p l ∧ x (Fin.castAdd b p) = true ∧ x (Fin.natAdd a l) = true) ∧ C.gates[k']? = some g' ∧ g'.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ a + b + k ∈ g'.inputs) → ∀ C0 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, C0 = { gates := C.gates.map (fun h0 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate => ({ op := h0.op, inputs := h0.inputs.map (fun s0 : ℕ => if s0 = a + b + j then a + b + C.size else s0) } : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate)), output := C.output } → ∀ Z : ℕ → Prop, (∀ i : ℕ, Z i ↔ ∀ x : Fin (a + b) → Bool, (C0.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD i false = false) → ∃ K : Finset (Fin a ⊕ Fin b), (∀ (p : Fin a) (l : Fin b), E p l → C0.eval (List.ofFn (fun t1 : Fin (a + b) => decide (t1 = Fin.castAdd b p) || decide (t1 = Fin.natAdd a l))) = false → Sum.inl p ∈ K ∨ Sum.inr l ∈ K) ∧ {k : ℕ | ∃ g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate, C0.gates[k]? = some g ∧ (∀ s1 ∈ g.inputs, ¬ Z s1) ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (fun y z : ℕ => ∃ (k1 : ℕ) (g1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C0.gates[k1]? = some g1 ∧ y ∈ g1.inputs ∧ z = a + b + k1 ∧ ¬ Z z) (a + b + k) C0.output}.ncard + {e : Fin a × Fin b | E e.1 e.2 ∧ C0.eval (List.ofFn (fun t2 : Fin (a + b) => decide (t2 = Fin.castAdd b e.1) || decide (t2 = Fin.natAdd a e.2))) = false}.ncard + K.card + {k : ℕ | ∃ g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate, C.gates[k]? = some g ∧ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ a + b + j ∈ g.inputs}.ncard ≤ C.size + 1
plain_statement: Bipartite graph, no 4-cycle. C: AND/OR gates, each reads only earlier wires, two distinct, output last, computes the edge function F, rigid (no read can be fixed to 0 or 1 keeping F). Gate c: false at each one-hot input, true at some non-edge input, read by r gates (r at least 2), r_AND of them AND; no sandwich (an OR reading c and a wire below F, read by an AND). C0: every read of c set to false. D: edges C0 rejects. KEPT: gates of C0 with no constant false input, reaching the output via gates not constant false. Then |KEPT| + |D| + (a vertex cover of D) <= |C| + 1 - r_AND.
title: Rigid fan-in-two AND/OR edge circuits, no 4-cycle: gate false on one-hot inputs, read twice, no sandwich: cut and stars add at most 1 - r_AND
